verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Sardine publishes an llms.txt at docs.sardine.ai that returns HTTP 200 and indexes the docs as Markdown (.md) pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. However, the docs say the integration guides, API references and SDKs are protected, which limits what an agent can reach without access. Missing for 10: agent access to the gated API references and SDK docs, any agent-specific documentation guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.sardine.ai/llms.txt # Sardine
[Home](https://docs.sardine.ai/home.md): Sardine documentation hub for fraud prevention,
